title: HS60018: Conflict Resolution & Negotiation
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Course Content
Nature and types of conflict, sources of conflict, conflict handling styles,
resolving conflict through various means especially through effective
communication skills; Understanding bargaining, factors affecting bargaining,
bargaining styles; Negotiation process, role of collective bargaining and
collaboration, developing effective negotiation skills.
